_note: v3.0 F3 (controller audit risk 8: concurrent side passes / --parallel 2 change inner-beat freshness). Model lane through the local controller, inner voice on (both cast members carry a drive): four real group turns, then the session journal's per-draft inner-beat lines are counted. Every drafted member must get a beat built for this turn (Inner beat used); a stale beat (built on an older reply) or no beat at its chat request fails the check. Floor 100 % (audit). No journal line at all fails as vacuous. The last step keeps the counts in the run record. Run on the controller under test, parallel 1 and parallel 2, same build. GPU: yes (live controller).

requires.why: the inner beat races its member's real chat request on the controller under test

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); const settings = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings(); return { innerVoice: settings.inner ?? null };

I can pay half now and half on the other side.
Fine. Here is the full fare.

steps.eval: const events = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal() ?? []; const lines = events.map((event) => /^(Inner beat used|Inner beat stale|No inner beat) for (.+)$/.exec(String(event.summary ?? ''))).filter(Boolean); if (!lines.length) throw new Error('vacuous: no inner beat journal line (inner voice off, or no member drafted)'); const counts = { used: 0, stale: 0, none: 0 }; const byMember = {}; for (const match of lines) { const kind = match[1] === 'Inner beat used' ? 'used' : match[1] === 'Inner beat stale' ? 'stale' : 'none'; counts[kind] += 1; byMember[match[2]] = byMember[match[2]] ?? { used: 0, stale: 0, none: 0 }; byMember[match[2]][kind] += 1; } if (counts.stale || counts.none) throw new Error('an inner beat was not fresh at its member chat request: ' + JSON.stringify({ counts, byMember })); return { counts, byMember };
